amendment.policy: Changing thresholds after exploratory scores are inspected is prohibited. Any amendment must be recorded and frozen before the affected exploratory evidence is read; the values below are the complete freeze-time statement of what any single-knob threshold change would do.

qualification_rule: a combination is qualified only if every planned run sharing its defense label is complete and qualified in every calibration seed (strict, fail-closed); one qualified target never qualifies another
scope: Classification follows the frozen R1 protocol over the declared finite cell set and the declared qualified attack suite. It establishes no universal trilemma, no hardware necessity, and no complete-transcript privacy claim.
